biggest_catch: Threshold trap: the $150 credit ONLY applies in months you use 2,000 kWh or more — use less and you get no credit at all, while the plan's underlying rate may still be higher than a cheaper basic plan.
catches: The $150 bill credit applies only in billing cycles where your usage is at or above 2,000 kWh; below the threshold there is no credit.
Plan-rate risk: always compare the Discount Deals plan's total bill against competing plans at YOUR usage level — the credit only wins for high-usage households.
Early-termination fees may apply if you leave the plan early — check the plan's disclosure PDF before enrolling.
Credit reduces the bill — savings on planned energy spending, not income.
No credit in any billing cycle with usage below 2,000 kWh; the $150 is a bill credit, not cash.
